bio_en: Shirin Yeghiazarian was born in April 1876 in Kharakonis in the Archak district of Vaspurakan and educated himself from 1893 on revolutionary books and papers. In 1895 he helped the Armenakan Movses Ter-Hovhannisian organise the villages, and from 1898 served seven years as village clerk to further the cause. He formally joined the ARF in 1905, receiving instructions from Vahan Papazian (Koms), and from late 1907 was hunted by Kurdish chiefs and officials, living as a fugitive and briefly imprisoned in Van. He combined organising and educational work in Vaspurakan, and died in Alexandropol on 2 October 1920.
